signal_scale: Instrument-export count values; no radiometric or inter-gain calibration applied
extraction_scope: All recorded top spectra and literal cells from the source workbook; bottom and absorbance read intensities are not included
raw_cell_policy: Numeric values, literal cell strings, cell-type codes, source row/column indices and all 455-870 nm channels preserved. Peak and normalization fields in the archive are verified caches, not independent measurements.
